quotes.text: D321244 instead defined `retainsCalendarEventSource`. The mismatch prevented retention, so `onCalendarEventSourceLoaded` received no event and failed when accessing `event.calendar`. The approved narrow fix renamed it to `retainsRawCalendarEvent` at `calendar-dialog.mjs:154`, preserving loader, route, rendering, and close behavior. [Task 1]
